description: We are a team of curious minds passionate about science, technology, and innovation. We believe that great ideas begin with asking questions and exploring possibilities beyond the obvious. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to combine creativity, data, and technology to develop meaningful solutions to real-world challenges. We welcome enthusiastic teammates who love learning, sharing ideas, and turning curiosity into innovation.
summary:
StarHealers is an intelligent astronaut health monitoring and mission-support platform designed to address the challenges of maintaining crew well-being during space exploration, where access to immediate medical assistance is limited.

Our solution integrates six interconnected capabilities: real-time and historical health monitoring, an interactive human body map, intelligent health triage, explainable countermeasure recommendations, cognitive performance assessment through PVT, and mission readiness evaluation. Enhanced anomaly detection and supporting features such as webcam-based pulse estimation further strengthen health assessment.

By combining physiological indicators, health trends, risk identification and mission-related assessments, StarHealers helps transform scattered health information into meaningful insights. It aims to help mission teams recognise unusual changes, understand potential health concerns and make more informed decisions.

Ultimately, StarHealers focuses on a critical aspect of space exploration: protecting astronaut health while supporting safer, smarter and more sustainable missions beyond Earth.
details:
StarHealers is an intelligent astronaut health monitoring and mission-support platform designed to support crew safety during space exploration.

It integrates six key capabilities: health monitoring, an interactive human body map, intelligent health triage, countermeasure recommendations, PVT-based cognitive assessment and mission readiness evaluation. It analyses health indicators, identifies unusual changes, provides understandable alerts and helps mission teams make informed decisions.

The project aims to improve early risk awareness, simplify health assessment and support safer long-duration space missions.

We developed it using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript and Python with FastAPI, along with data visualisation and storage technologies. GitHub supports team collaboration.

Its creativity lies in combining physical health monitoring, cognitive assessment and mission readiness in one connected platform, with a focus on clarity, usability and explainable health insights.
